title: Blueberry Whipped Cream
description: Whipped cream flavored and tinted with chilled blueberry syrup.
beforeYouStart: Make the blueberry syrup ahead and chill it. Warm syrup deflates the cream.

steps.do: Whip the cream on its own to soft peaks.
steps.cue: Peaks that slump over when the whisk lifts out

steps.do: Turn the speed down and add the blueberry syrup.
Add the confectioners' sugar, then turn the speed back up and whip to medium-firm peaks.
steps.cue: Peaks that hold their shape with just the tip curling over

notes: Goes well on pavlova with fresh berries.

source.name: Jacob's own, worked out with Claude
